rv.q: And no matter how you feel about its denouement, City Garage’s latest is as gut-punchingly impactful as a production can get.
This play is driven by a tide of complex emotions and a near unabated tension, elements that director Michel’s smart direction bring into pointed relief without being heavy handed.

cn.t: City Garage's revival of Dorfman's political thriller lands as gripping and timely, with strong performances driving this thought-provoking tale of trauma and justice. Critics agree it's a riveting, recommended production.
